name: Acme_EchoHarness
author: Acme (example)
description: Reference harness plugin (HARNESS-PLUGIN-3): one harness, 'echo', whose agent process prints the prompt back. Harness half only; copy it as a community module and grant it in modules.json (harness.code, harness.setting:echo.prefix, harness.cli, harness.cli.install). Its cli block is the H5a reference: the harness installer offers and installs @acme/echo-harness-cli from it (the echo run itself needs no CLI).
